scripts:
set properties on /content/dam/mvw/jcr:content
  set cq:conf{String} to /conf/mvw
  set jcr:title{String} to "Marriott Vacations Worldwide"
end

set properties on /content/dam/legal/jcr:content
  set cq:conf{String} to /conf/legal
  set jcr:title{String} to "MVW Governing Documents "
end

set properties on /content/tmvcs/jcr:content
 set jcr:title{String} to "TMVCs"
end

set properties on /content/dam/tmvcs/jcr:content
  set jcr:title{String} to "TMVCs DAM"
end

set properties on /content/dam/legalwebpages/jcr:content
  set jcr:title{String} to "MVW Legal WebPages"
end
create service user mvw-service-reader with forced path system/cq:services/mvw

set principal ACL for mvw-service-reader
  allow jcr:read on /etc/acs-commons/lists/mvwlegal-language-specifier
  allow jcr:read on /etc/acs-commons/lists/mvwlegal-language-specifier/jcr:content
  allow jcr:read on /content
  allow jcr:read on /content/dam
  allow jcr:read on /var/workflow/instances
end
create service user mvw-service-writer with forced path system/cq:services/mvw

set principal ACL for mvw-service-writer
  allow jcr:all on /var
  allow jcr:all on /conf
  allow jcr:all on /content/dam
end
create service user mvw-workflow-user with forced path system/cq:services/mvw

set principal ACL for mvw-workflow-user
  allow jcr:all on /var/workflow/instances
  allow jcr:read on /home/users
  allow jcr:read on /home/groups
  allow jcr:all, rep:write, crx:replicate on /content/tmvcs
end
# 1. mvw-content-managers - Same access as AEM's administrators group
# 2. mvw-global-technology-bau - Same access as AEM's administrators group
# 3. mvw-content-coordinators - Can edit content across all projects, Not an administrator

set ACL for mvw-content-coordinators
  allow jcr:read, rep:write, jcr:versionManagement, jcr:lockManagement, crx:replicate on /content/tmvcs
  allow jcr:read, rep:write, jcr:versionManagement, jcr:lockManagement on /content/dam
  allow jcr:read on /content/experience-fragments
  allow jcr:read on /conf
end
# 4. mvw-creatives - Has write access only to AEM DAM, across all projects

set ACL for mvw-creatives
  allow jcr:read, rep:write, jcr:versionManagement, jcr:lockManagement on /content/dam
  allow jcr:read on /content/tmvcs
  allow jcr:read on /conf
end
# 5. mvw-product-owners-tmvcs - Can edit content only on tmvcs sites and DAM

set ACL for mvw-product-owners-tmvcs
  allow jcr:read, rep:write, jcr:versionManagement, jcr:lockManagement on /content/tmvcs
  allow jcr:read, rep:write, jcr:versionManagement, jcr:lockManagement on /content/dam
  allow jcr:read on /conf
end
# 7. mvw-legal-tmvcs - Read only access for sites and DAM

set ACL for mvw-legal-tmvcs
  allow jcr:read on /content/tmvcs
  allow jcr:read on /content/dam
  allow jcr:read on /conf
end
# 9. mvw-io-tmvcs - Read only access for sites and DAM

set ACL for mvw-io-tmvcs
  allow jcr:read on /content/tmvcs
  allow jcr:read on /content/dam
  allow jcr:read on /conf
end
# 11. mvw-external-partner-tmvcs - Read only access for sites and DAM

set ACL for mvw-external-partner-tmvcs
  allow jcr:read on /content/tmvcs
  allow jcr:read on /content/dam
  allow jcr:read on /conf
end
# 13. mvw-qa-tmvcs - Read only access for sites and DAM

set ACL for mvw-qa-tmvcs
  allow jcr:read on /content/tmvcs
  allow jcr:read on /content/dam
  allow jcr:read on /conf
end
# 18. mvw-law-registration-governingdocs - Legal registration access for author/dev
# 19. mvw-law-registration-reviewers - Legal registration access for author/dev

set ACL on /,/content,/content/dam,/content/experience-fragments (ACLOptions=mergePreserve)
  allow jcr:read for mvw-law-registration-reviewers
end

set ACL on /content/legal,/content/dam/legal,/content/dam/legalwebpages,/content/experience-fragments/legal (ACLOptions=mergePreserve)
  allow jcr:read for mvw-law-registration-reviewers
end

set ACL on /content/brightcovetools,/content/campaigns,/content/cq:graphql,/content/launches,/content/mvw,/content/outbound-marketing,/content/tmvcs,/content/usergenerated,/content/dam/assetinsights,/content/dam/brightcove_assets,/content/dam/collections,/content/dam/mvw,/content/dam/tmvcs,/content/experience-fragments/mvw,/content/experience-fragments/tmvcs (ACLOptions=mergePreserve)
  deny jcr:read for mvw-law-registration-reviewers
end
# mvw-reviewer - Can annotate, provide feedback comments, progress workflow step

set ACL for mvw-reviewer
 deny crx:replicate on /content/tmvcs
 deny crx:replicate on /content/dam/mvw
 allow jcr:read, rep:write on /var/workflow/instances
end
# mvw-publisher - All that reviewers can do, plus: Can initiate workflow, Can publish content

set ACL for mvw-publisher
 allow crx:replicate on /content/tmvcs
 allow crx:replicate on /content/dam/mvw
 allow jcr:all on /conf
 allow jcr:read, rep:write, jcr:versionManagement on /var/workflow
 allow jcr:read, rep:write on /etc/workflow
end
# Groups that inherit from mvw-publisher (can initiate workflow and publish)
# Groups that inherit from mvw-reviewer (can annotate, feedback, progress workflow)

create user qa-reviewer with password qa-reviewer
create user copyproofread-reviewer with password copyproofread-reviewer
create user business-reviewer with password business-reviewer
create user legal-reviewer with password legal-reviewer
